messages.subject: shapeHull polygons mix individuals of different groups
parts:
Hi geomorph users,

I was plotting some PCA with my data and I notice that the polygons created by the shapeHull function mixed some individuals of different groups.

I will thank you  a lot for any help or insight about what could be happening.
Bellow I share a sample of my code and I attached the plot

I am using geomorph version 4.0.1 in a Ubuntu 16.04 LTS


Best

Julio
#######
 PCA_dorsal <- gm.prcomp(gdf_dorsal$coords)
PCA_plot <- plot(PCA_dorsal,
                 pch = c(21, 15),
                 cex= 1.5)
shapeHulls(PCA_plot,
           groups = gdf_dorsal$group,
           group.cols = c("green", "orange"),
           group.lwd = rep(3, 2),
           group.lty = c(1, 3))
legend('topright',
       legend= c('sp 1','sp 2'),
       col= c("green", "orange"),
       lwd= 2,
       lty = c(1,3))

parts:
Julio,

 

Check the plot color for your group designation. I just ran things on other data and it works fine (repeatable code below).


Dean

 

data("pupfish")

gdf <- geomorph.data.frame(coords = pupfish$coords, Sex = pupfish$Sex,

                           Pop = pupfish$Pop)

fit <- procD.lm(coords ~ Pop * Sex, data = gdf, print.progress = FALSE)

groups <- interaction(gdf$Pop, gdf$Sex)

pc.plot <- plot(fit, type = "PC", pch = 19,col=groups)

 

 

shapeHulls(pc.plot, groups = groups,

           group.cols = c("dark red", "dark red", "dark blue", "dark blue"),

           group.lwd = rep(2, 4), group.lty = c(2, 1, 2, 1))
